body:
Being that I have been on a little opiate binge lately I wanted to try something that would get me to outerspace. So I hear about a couple of patches and lollipops that are in town. I decide to go the safe route and get the lollipop instead of the patch, because of the dangers of mis-dosing when eating the gel. I paid 40$ for a 400 microgram pop, headed to a reputably website to read all the experiences to gain any insight whatsoever for what I was facing. Then did some further research to figure out how to appropriately take the lollipop for the lack of information. So I figure the buccal administration of 400 mcg was probably a way too high of a dose for me, so I decided to put the lollipop in my mouth for approximately 7 1/2 minutes. The whole pop is supposed to last around 15 minutes. Thus, I would have started my original dosing around 200 micrograms.
T (4:30am): Being a person who has their mind set on anything, I couldn't wait for the next day to pop this sucker in. I take the lolly, twist and twirled the sucker against my cheek for 7 1/2 minutes.
T (4:38am): I read that you should feel the dosage almost instantly, wondering why I'm not feeling anything yet... as I hold the saliva in my mouth for the best possible absorption.
T (4:45): I feel slightly as if nothing matters, just an empty feeling. No euphoria, only a slight dissassociative feeling. Possibly similar to a bump of K. I decide this is a joke. I swallowed the saliva that I was holding in my mouth. Threw the pop back in my mouth which lasted for about 8 minutes.
T (4:55): Nothing... Waiting for something to hit me...
T (5:15): Obvious slowed respiration, no euphoric feelings, no obvious high, wondering what the hell is going on.
T (5:30): Popped in a movie, figured hey it might take a while to kick in so ill kill some more time...
T (6:00): Still nothing, my dose was 400 mcg lolly. I have been taking 3-4 vicodins a day lately. I prefer the vicodins anyday, the high was obvious and there was less chatter about how unsafe a vicodin can be compared to fentanyl. I am pretty angry I wasted forty dollars to feel nothing.
T (9:00am): I feel like I got shammed. I read the half life of fentanyl is 90 minutes so I stayed up to this time just to make sure that it was safe to go to bed.
T (2:30pm): Woke up from a pretty restless sleep... bummed at this weak experience.
Overall Conclusion:
My daily resistance built up from low dosages of opiates inhibited any and all positive feelings that could come from this lollipop. For indeed something that is said to be 100x more powerful then heroin should have given me some high, but a full consumption of the lollipop proved otherwise.  This drug felt way too synthetic in all aspects. This is around 14 hours later and i've had a stomache ache since I woke up from a normal sleep at 2:30pm.  I am done with fentanyl after this bum experience and am not willing to pay the high price for nothing.
